joint_limit_and_default_pose_audit.why_recorded_here: a parallel session asked whether the swap moves the standing-pose-vs-limit envelope; it does not, and the numbers belong with the swap evidence

hard_limits_0409_to_0807.conclusion: bit-identical, so pp_joint_limits.hpp and every envelope/bandwidth/dose number built on it survive the swap unchanged

pp_joint_limits_hpp_cross_check.note: the residual is the header's own 5-decimal rounding, not drift

eight_percent_envelope_check.what_0_08_actually_is: margin_frac in _qdes_limit_barrier_values (hope_rewards.py:2294), the soft-limit barrier REWARD's guard band -- not a hard gate and not an admission criterion
eight_percent_envelope_check.basis_correction: the barrier uses the SOFT limits (soft_joint_pos_limit_factor=0.9, shrunk about the range midpoint), not the URDF hard limits
eight_percent_envelope_check.stance_is_exempt_by_design: hope_rewards.py:2301 sets m_j = min(margin_frac, d_default_j - STANCE_EPS) with STANCE_EPS=0.005 (:2277), so a joint whose default stance already sits closer than 8% to a soft limit gets a NARROWER guard band rather than a standing penalty
eight_percent_envelope_check.verdict: not a defect and not bad vendor data: the two shoulder_roll joints simply run a ~2.5% guard band instead of 8%, which the code was written to accommodate
eight_percent_envelope_check.swap_neutral: hard limits are bit-identical across 0409->0807 on all 31 joints (max abs difference 0.0) and the defaults were not touched, so this swap neither creates nor fixes it

joint_limit_and_default_pose_audit.grounding_measurements_need_recomputatio: yes: both ankle_pitch lateral offsets went +-1.5 mm to 0, which is on the foot chain, so a sink/knee-angle grounding measured on the previous plant does not transfer
